# 👨‍🎓 About Me

- 👋 Hi there! I'm **ChengAo Shen (沈骋骜)**, an AI researcher who also loves turning ideas into software people actually use.
- 🎓 I'm a Ph.D. student in Computer Science at the [University of Houston](https://uh.edu/). My research sits at the intersection of **time series analysis** and **LLM-based agent systems**: distilling what large pre-trained models know into accurate, lightweight forecasters, and designing multi-agent systems that automate complex analytical workflows and stay reliable while doing it. My work has appeared at **EMNLP, NeurIPS, ACL and IJCAI**.
- 🐱 Outside the lab, I founded [CatVinci Studio](https://catvinci.com) to explore what agents can do for modern office work: AI that works right out of the box and quietly fits into how you already read, write and organize. Our most mature project is [Levis](https://github.com/CatVinci-Studio/Levis), a free, open-source, cross-platform Markdown editor with AI built in.
- 💬 Always happy to chat about time series, agents, or anything in between. Feel free to reach out!
